purpose: Emit the invite_lifecycle 'invited' group announcement exactly at the direct-invite call site (InviteMemberModal.tsx's submitInviteWithMarker, wired from pages/groups.tsx), fire-and-forget, only after a successful MLS Add. Must never be reachable from the join-request/invite-link approval flow (approveJoinRequestImpl / inviteByNpub), which is out of scope and already emits its own member_admitted announcement (DD-8).

public_api.name: buildInvitedAnnouncementContent
public_api.description: Pure payload builder. Returns JSON.stringify({ type: 'invite_lifecycle', event: 'invited', pubkey: <canonical lowercase-hex inviteeHex> }). No side effects; testable in isolation.

public_api.name: submitInviteWithMarker
public_api.signature: (pubkeyHex: string, groupId: string, inviteByNpub: (groupId: string, npub: string) => Promise<{ok: boolean; error?: string}>, markerDeps: PendingInviteMarkerDeps, sendAnnouncement?: (content: string) => Promise<void>) => Promise<{ok: boolean; error?: string}>
public_api.description: Existing exported async core (unchanged marker bookkeeping behavior). Extended with a new optional 5th param: on result.ok === true, fires buildInvitedAnnouncementContent(canonicalPubkey) through sendAnnouncement, fire-and-forget (never awaited, .catch(()=>{}) swallows any rejection). Never invoked when the invite fails. Backward compatible: omitting the param preserves prior behavior exactly (no announcement sent).

public_api.name: InviteMemberModal
public_api.signature: (props: { isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; groupId: string; sendAnnouncement?: (content: string) => Promise<void> }) => JSX.Element
public_api.description: Default export React component. New optional sendAnnouncement prop threaded straight through to submitInviteWithMarker inside handleInvite. All other props/behavior unchanged.

public_api.name: submitInvite
public_api.signature: (pubkeyHex: string, groupId: string, inviteByNpub) => Promise<{ok: boolean; error?: string}>
public_api.description: Unchanged (pre-existing export). Not touched by this story — the producer is wired one layer up, in submitInviteWithMarker, so submitInvite (also reachable in principle without the marker wrapper) never fires an announcement itself. inviteByNpub itself remains completely untouched (DD-8).

public_api.name: computeSelectionState
public_api.signature: (entries, selectedPubkeyHex: string) => { hasSelectable: boolean; isSelectionValid: boolean }

dependencies_forbidden: app/src/context/MarmotContext.tsx's inviteByNpub (DD-8: shared with the out-of-scope join-request/invite-link flow — must remain untouched)
app/src/context/MarmotContext.tsx's approveJoinRequestImpl (out-of-scope join-request flow; already emits member_admitted independently and must not gain an invite_lifecycle side effect)

app/src/lib/marmot/parseStructured.ts (S1's owned parse boundary — this producer only constructs a JSON string matching the InviteLifecycleContent seam shape by convention; it does not import S1's guard/type)
events_emitted: group application rumor (kind-9, via the existing sendMessage/sendApplicationRumor channel captured as sendAnnouncementRef in pages/groups.tsx): { type: 'invite_lifecycle', event: 'invited', pubkey: <inviteeHex> }
